findings.summary: crates/server/src/board.rs:76-77: needs_you lists every non-draft PR with green checks as 'merge', whatever stage its ticket is in. AC-2 asks for a PR 'waiting for the owner's merge', and the owner merges only after the PR review gate. What you would see: a ticket in Build or Verify whose CI is green (this branch's own PR, for example) shows as 'Merge: TRU-10 ...' in Needs you before its review has run. The PR also gets listed when its ticket is closed or isn't on the board. No test covers a green PR whose ticket is not yet in PR review.
findings.reason: Fixed: only PRs whose open ticket is in PR review are listed; needs_you.rs covers a green PR still in Build.

findings.summary: crates/server/src/github.rs:57 with crates/server/src/board.rs:51: since 3d4eb1e a PR is tied to the first ID anywhere in its title, or else its body. Combined with `prs.iter().find`, a non-pipeline PR that only mentions a ticket now takes over that ticket. Examples: title 'Follow-up to TRU-6: ...', or a 'Bump deps' PR whose body says 'unblocks TRU-8'. Either can be the PR shown on that ticket's card, depending on the order GitHub lists them, and either gets a 'merge' item once green. If one ticket has two PRs, one is shown and the other is dropped without being logged. crates/server/tests/github.rs only tests that one PR per ticket gets tied correctly, not that a second one doesn't collide.

crates/server/src/github.rs:405-418 (checks): only check-runs are read, not commit statuses. A PR with no check runs is 'pending' forever. Verify saw this on sdlc-board 3b60d49 (0 runs, 'checks pending'), so a repo without Actions CI never gets a 'merge' item. Still open from Build round 1 and Verify round 1.

crates/server/src/github.rs:53-71 (prs): each per-PR check-runs or contents call ends in `?`. One 403 or 5xx on any single PR fails the whole GitHub read, and every repo keeps its stale PR list. The pulls and check-runs calls also read only the first page (per_page=100) and don't log when there are more. Still open from Build round 1.
